metadata.title: Free Website Scan | Vivotiv
metadata.description: Find out what's wrong with your website in 60 seconds. Check performance, SEO, accessibility, GDPR compliance, and security for free.

hero.headline: Get a free health check for your website
hero.subheadline: Understand what's affecting your Google ranking, legal compliance, and visitor experience with a free report.
hero.success: Scan submitted. We'll email you when results are ready.
hero.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

categories.title: We check what actually matters
categories.subtitle: Poor performance, broken SEO, and missing compliance cost you visitors, revenue, and credibility every day your site stays unfixed.

performance.title: Performance & Speed
performance.description: Slow pages lose visitors before they even load. Google ranks them lower too. We measure the same things Google does when deciding where your site appears.

seo.title: SEO
seo.description: If search engines can't read your pages properly, customers won't find you. We check whether Google can discover, understand, and rank your site.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.description: Since June 2025, most EU businesses are legally required to have accessible websites. We check if yours meets the requirements.

legal.title: EU Legal Compliance
legal.description: Missing cookie consent, no privacy policy, tracking before user approval. These are the things that lead to fines.

security.title: Security
security.description: Outdated software and missing security headers make your site an easy target. Most of these issues are invisible until something breaks.

standards.title: Modern Web Standards
standards.description: Broken mobile layouts, deprecated code, missing pages. These signal to visitors that your business doesn't invest in its online presence.

reportPreview.title: A full breakdown of what needs attention
reportPreview.subtitle: You get a scored breakdown of your site with specific issues, why they matter to your business, and what needs to change.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: A clear path from problems to solutions.

step1.title: Paste your URL
step1.description: Any publicly accessible website. WordPress, Wix, custom built, anything.

step2.title: Enter your email
step2.description: We send the full report to your inbox when it's done. Nothing else.

step3.title: Get your report
step3.description: Scores, issues, and recommendations across all six categories. Share it with your team or your developer.

step4.title: Take action
step4.description: Use the report to fix things yourself, hand it to your developer, or let us handle it.

audience.title: Who this is for
audience.subtitle: Whether you run the website or report on it.

business.title: Business owners
business.description: You know your site needs work but not what's wrong or where to start. This report gives you the answers.

marketing.title: Marketing managers
marketing.description: You need hard numbers to justify a website investment to leadership. This report is the business case.

developer.title: Developers
developer.description: A quick audit across performance, security, and standards without running five different tools.

agency.title: Agencies
agency.description: Send clients a scored report instead of explaining why their site needs a rebuild. Let the numbers talk.

compliance.title: The EU Accessibility Act is law
compliance.description: Since June 2025, businesses with 10+ employees or €2M+ turnover must meet WCAG 2.1 AA. Non-compliance means fines up to €3M. Most Swedish businesses don't know this applies to them yet.

stat1.label: Maximum fine in Sweden for non-compliance

stat2.label: Required standard under the EU Accessibility Act

stat3.label: Employees or annual turnover threshold for enforcement

gdpr.title: Cookie compliance is not optional
gdpr.description: Your cookie banner needs an equally prominent reject button. Loading analytics before consent is a direct GDPR violation. IMY has been issuing formal warnings to Swedish businesses since April 2025.

stat1.label: Maximum GDPR fine, whichever is higher

stat2.label: Issued formal reprimands to Swedish companies in April 2025

stat3.label: Rejecting cookies must be as easy as accepting them

gdpr.cta: Scan your site for cookie issues

faq.title: Questions & answers
faq.subtitle: What you need to know before scanning.

items.question: Is this really free?
items.answer: Yes. No credit card, no hidden costs, no catch. But if the results are rough, don't be surprised if we offer to help.

items.question: What happens with my email?
items.answer: We use it to send your report and occasionally follow up with relevant offers. We never share it with third parties.

items.question: How long does the scan take?
items.answer: About 60 seconds. We run automated checks against your site covering all six categories in real time.

items.question: What does the report include?
items.answer: A score for each of the six categories, a list of every issue we found, and what to do about each one.

items.question: Who is Vivotiv?
items.answer: A Swedish company that helps businesses modernize their websites. We built this scan to show site owners exactly what they're missing.

bottomCta.title: Most businesses don't realize how much their website is costing them
bottomCta.subtitle: The report your web developer should have given you already.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Vivotiv ("we", "us", "our") collects, uses, and protects your personal data when you use vivotiv.com and vivotiv.se (the "Service").

controller.title: 1. Data Controller
controller.name: Vivotiv
controller.contact: If you have questions about how we handle your personal data, contact us at that address.

leadData.title: Scan submissions
leadData.description: When you submit a website scan, we collect your email address and the website URL you enter. This data is stored in our database so we can process the scan and send you the results.

scan.purpose: Processing website scans and delivering results

processors.title: 4. Data Processors (Sub-processors)
processors.intro: We share data with the following third-party processors to operate the Service:

transfers.title: 5. International Data Transfers
transfers.description: Some of our processors (Vercel) operate in the United States. Where personal data is transferred outside the EU/EEA, we rely on Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) approved by the European Commission to ensure adequate protection.

leads.data: Email and URL from scan submissions

rights.title: 7. Your Rights
rights.intro: Under the GDPR you have the right to:

access.title: Access
access.description: — request a copy of the personal data we hold about you.

rectification.title: Rectification
rectification.description: — ask us to correct inaccurate data.

erasure.title: Erasure
erasure.description: — ask us to delete your personal data.

restriction.title: Restriction
restriction.description: — ask us to restrict processing in certain circumstances.

portability.title: Data portability
portability.description: — receive your data in a machine-readable format.

object.title: Object
object.description: — object to processing based on legitimate interests.

withdraw.title: Withdraw consent
withdraw.description: — withdraw consent at any time via the Cookie Preferences link in the footer.

rights.exercise: To exercise any right, email us at

authority.title: 8. Supervisory Authority
authority.description: You have the right to lodge a complaint with the Swedish Authority for Privacy Protection (Integritetsskyddsmyndigheten, IMY) at

changes.title: 9. Changes to This Policy
changes.description: We may update this policy from time to time. The "Last updated" date at the top of this page reflects the most recent revision.

cookiePolicy.title: Cookie Policy
cookiePolicy.intro: This Cookie Policy explains what cookies Vivotiv uses, why we use them, and how you can control them.

whatAreCookies.title: What are cookies?
whatAreCookies.description: Cookies are small text files stored on your device by your browser. They allow a website to remember information about your visit across page loads and sessions.

necessary.title: Strictly Necessary
necessary.description: These cookies are required for the site to function. They cannot be disabled.

locale.purpose: Stores your language preference so the site displays in the correct language.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.description: We do not currently use any analytics cookies. If this changes, we will update this policy and request your consent before setting any analytics cookies.

managing.title: Managing your preferences
managing.description: You can change your cookie preferences at any time:
managing.preferences: Use the Cookie Preferences link in the page footer to update your choices.
managing.browser: You can also clear cookies via your browser settings.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: Questions about this Cookie Policy? Email us at

banner.message: We use cookies to improve your experience.

preferences.title: Cookie Preferences
preferences.description: Manage which cookies you allow. You can change these settings at any time.

necessary.title: Strictly Necessary
